from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper: its title and which other papers from the provided collection it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the collection that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
